units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:22">Lam. R. to III, 16</cite> <he>אצל המגרוס</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="Q01852"><he>פָּרָכוּטֵס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 643:22">Yalk. Lev. 643</cite>, a. e. (<he>מְגִרְסָךְ</he>) <he>מְגִירְסָךְ אנא</he> I (the Lord) am thy cook (ripening thy fruits); Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 70ᵃ <he>מגיסך</he> (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>כמו גרייס</he> read: <he>כמגירוס</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, end <he>מ׳ של בו״ד</he> (not <cite ref="M00177"><he>מגירם</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00153"><he>מגידם</he></cite>) the cook of a human master.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:5:2">Y. Keth. I, 25ᶜ</cite> <he>קול מגרוס בעיר</he> when it was announced that a cook (or baker) was in town (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 32b:9">Snh. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>קול רחים</he>).—Pl. <he>מְגִירוֹסִין</he>, <he>מְגִירְסִין</he>.
